units.source_text: “看完书要睡觉的时候，一拉这根绳就能关灯。”

en.t: When you have finished reading and are going to sleep, you can turn off the light just by pulling this cord.

units.source_text: 驹子一边说，一边抚弄着那根细绳。

en.t: Komako said this while fingering the thin cord.

units.source_text: 但是，她却像家庭妇女似的，温驯地坐着，显得有点腼腆。

en.t: But she sat there meekly, like a housewife, and looked a little shy.
